pollination.title: File:European honey bee extracts nectar.jpg
pollination.author: John Severns (Severnjc)
pollination.desc: A European honey bee (Apis mellifera) extracts nectar from an Aster flower using its proboscis. Tiny hairs covering the bee's body maintain a slight electrostatic charge, causing pollen from the flower's anthers to stick to the bee, allowing for pollination when the bee moves on to another flower.
